413ce6a193.q: What cost of living factors make Honolulu a dangerous location for new dental practices?
413ce6a193.a: Honolulu sits among the least competitive tax climates and highest cost of living in the United States. Commercial rent, housing for associates, and wages for hygienists and support staff all exceed mainland startup requirements. Tourism dependency makes the economy and appointment book fragile, with slow seasons, flight cancellations, or poor visitor years significantly impacting local patient loads.
